entries.appliesTo: healthcare professionals licensed under Title 37 who record appointments or treatment for AI transcription

dutySources.disclosure-ui: § 22.1(A) — 'shall verbally disclose the use of any recording device, software, or service to a patient before recording any part of an appointment or treatment to be transcribed by artificial intelligence'

sources.aiPracticeRule: § 22.1(A) — 'A healthcare professional licensed by this Title shall verbally disclose the use of any recording device, software, or service to a patient'
sources.scope: § 22.1(A) — 'before recording any part of an appointment or treatment to be transcribed by artificial intelligence'
sources.enforcer: § 22.1(B) — 'may be subject to disciplinary action by his professional licensing board'

flags: civil-liability immunity provision: § 22.1(B) — 'shall be immune from civil liability in the absence of gross negligence or willful misconduct'
no monetary penalty stated; sole enforcement is licensing-board disciplinary action
scope param coded 'treatment' — statute covers 'any part of an appointment or treatment', which the fixed enum (licensure|treatment|all) captures only approximately
